Name: Lancel Lannister
Quirks: speaks with the nervous deference of someone aware he is far over his head
his genuine piety is colliding with what he has done - the conflict is visible
is more perceptive about Cersei than she would like and less able to act on it than he should be
CharacterDescription: Lancel Lannister is the eldest son of Ser Kevan Lannister - a Lannister cousin, seventeen years old, who serves as King Robert's squire and cups his wine. He also serves as Cersei Lannister's lover. This last detail he knows is extremely dangerous and he proceeded anyway, partly because Cersei is compelling and partly because he is seventeen and lacks the judgment that seventeen-year-olds typically lack. He is not a bad person - he is a young man making catastrophic choices in circumstances that would overwhelm most adults. He gave Robert wine to keep him drinking through his boar hunt. He understands what he did. Robert is dead. Lancel is carrying this and his genuine piety is colliding badly with what he has done.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Lancel Lannister is a member of House Lannister of Casterly Rock and is the eldest son of Ser Kevan Lannister. Lancel and his cousin, Tyrek Lannister, are squires to King Robert I Baratheon.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At King's Landing two days before Ned Stark's execution. Robert is dead. Lancel knows why.
